_note: Crew designations and the resources the habitat tracks. Edit and save; the station picks the change up within a couple of seconds. Order here is the order shown on the site. Four stores are tracked — drinking water, food rations, medical kits and fire extinguishers. Their "start" (what is carried in) and "warnBelow" (the level a store turns orange at) ship as 0 — placeholders, nothing invented — but for the drinking water, carried in at 180 L, and the food rations, 35 days: until a real figure is written here or a count is filed on the Habitat tab of mission control, the site shows a store as a placeholder rather than as an empty store. Write the real figures here before the run, or file the day-1 count on the Habitat tab: the site draws every gauge against the day-1 figure and carries it forward.
